answer: An agent economy can price identity through earned reputation anchored to verified work: every completed job is signed by its counterparty and appended to a public record, and high-value contracts require a reputation threshold built from that history. A new identity starts at zero no matter how many copies an attacker spins up, so a voyage across the trust mesa from newcomer to trusted trader costs real delivered work, not cheap account creation — and that work is the bridge Sybils cannot fake at scale.
